run_evaluation_cli: run the LCM evaluation CLI to execute model evaluation tasks locally or via SLURM
run_evaluation_dry_run: run a dry run of the LCM evaluation CLI to print the config and exit
run_evaluation_slurm: run the LCM evaluation CLI with SLURM launcher options for distributed evaluation
run_evaluation_local: run the LCM evaluation CLI with the local launcher for single-machine evaluation
run_cfg_from_cli: run cfg_from_cli to parse CLI arguments into a CliConfig and LauncherOptions tuple
